description: Passages piétons sécurisés par des dispositifs lumineux is a dataset listed in GPSO - Grand Paris Seine Ouest - OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Passages piétons sécurisés par des dispositifs lumineux Flowell se distingue par l’installation de dalles lumineuses aux extrémités des bandes du passage. Ces dalles, activées par détection thermique lorsqu’un piéton entre dans la zone, améliorent la visibilité et incitent les automobilistes à ralentir et respecter les priorités. Coverage: Grand Paris Seine Ouest. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité, Environnement, Cadre de vie. The portal shows 21 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seineouest-fr-portal.
